pick.name: GitHub Spec Kit
pick.what: Spec-driven development toolkit: constitution -> spec -> plan -> tasks, with Claude Code support
pick.why: Free, MIT, GitHub-maintained, and it produces specs that Claude Code then implements in the same repo.

alts.name: BMAD-METHOD
alts.what: Agent-team method (analyst, PM, architect personas) for PRDs and stories
alts.why: Richer PM-persona flow for bigger products; heavier ceremony.
alts.maintained: stable v6.12; v7 Claude Code plugin in alpha

alts.name: ChatPRD
alts.why: Polished PRD templates if you do not want a repo-based flow.

candidates.name: Claude Code plan mode only
candidates.verdict: fine for small features, no durable spec

decision: Spec Kit keeps the PRD, plan and tasks as files beside the code, which is what Claude Code works best from. Use BMAD when a product needs a fuller PM/architect pass, ChatPRD only for client-facing PRD documents.

verify.note: Shallow check only: free/commercial terms are consistent with the cited licence; not re-opened in this pass.
